general.title: General Provisions
general.content: This Privacy Policy defines the procedure for processing and protecting personal data of WowRussian Analyzer service users. The Operator ensures protection of processed personal data from unauthorized access and disclosure in accordance with Federal Law No. 152-FZ dated July 27, 2006 'On Personal Data'.

operator.title: Personal Data Operator
operator.content: The personal data operator is the administration of WowRussian Analyzer service. Contact address: privacy@wowrussian.ru

collectedData.title: Collected Personal Data
collectedData.content: We collect and process the following categories of personal data:

items.password: Password hash (we do not store passwords in plain text)

purposes.title: Data Processing Purposes
purposes.content: Personal data is processed for the following purposes:

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.content: Personal data processing is carried out based on:

items.consent: Consent of the personal data subject (upon registration)
items.legitimateInterest: Legitimate interest of the operator (service improvement, security)

storage.title: Storage Periods
storage.content: Personal data is stored no longer than necessary for the purposes of its processing, unless otherwise established by the legislation of the Russian Federation. Users may request deletion of their data at any time.

rights.title: Rights of the Personal Data Subject
rights.content: In accordance with Federal Law No. 152-FZ, you have the right to:

items.complaint: File a complaint with Roskomnadzor to protect your rights

cookies.title: Use of Cookies
cookies.content: We use cookies to ensure service functionality, authentication, and website usage analysis. By continuing to use the website, you consent to the use of cookies.

thirdParty.title: Transfer to Third Parties
thirdParty.content: We do not transfer your personal data to third parties, except as provided by the legislation of the Russian Federation or necessary for service provision (e.g., to hosting providers).

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We take necessary organizational and technical measures to protect personal data from unauthorized access, loss, alteration, blocking, copying, and distribution.

changes.title: Changes to the Policy
changes.content: We reserve the right to make changes to this Privacy Policy. The current version is always available on this page.

contact.title: Contact Information
contact.content: For any questions regarding personal data processing, you can contact us at:

cookieConsent.message: We use cookies to ensure website functionality and improve service quality. By continuing to use the website, you consent to the use of cookies.
cookieConsent.learnMore: Learn more in the Privacy Policy

asIs.title: Service Provided 'As Is'
asIs.content: The service is provided without warranties of uninterrupted operation, security, or accuracy of results. We do not guarantee complete accuracy of foreign word detection and full compliance with all legislative requirements.

notLegalAdvice.title: Not Legal Advice
notLegalAdvice.content: The results of 168-FZ analysis are for informational purposes only and do not constitute a legal opinion. For official questions related to legal compliance, consult qualified legal professionals.

limitation.title: Limitation of Liability
limitation.content: The operator is not liable for decisions made based on the service analysis results. Use of the service is at your own risk.

dataPurpose.title: Purpose of Personal Data Collection
dataPurpose.content: Personal data is collected exclusively for the functioning of the service (authentication, project storage). Data is not sold or transferred to third parties, except as provided by the legislation of the Russian Federation.

cookies.title: Cookies and Analytics
cookies.content: We use cookies to ensure service functionality, authentication, and website usage analysis. You can manage cookie settings in your browser.

lawReference.title: Legal Framework
lawReference.content: Personal data processing is carried out in accordance with Federal Law No. 152-FZ dated July 27, 2006 'On Personal Data'.
